snippet.title: There Is mORE - Mining Roguelike with powerful spells - Early Access Trailer (short)
snippet.description:
Mine at day, defend at night. Upgrade your gear, unlock powerful spells, dig deeper, and survive 10 nights in There Is mORE.

Play There Is mORE in Early Access on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3931000/There_Is_mORE/?utm_source=y&utm_medium=t1&utm_campaign=2
Play There Is mORE in Early Access on EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/de/p/there-is-more-c6b8fc

Long description:
In There Is mORE you dig for precious ores by day and defend your city from relentless monsters by night. Each night the waves attacking the core are getting deadlier - upgrade your gear, unlock powerful spells, and descend deeper. Can you survive 10 nights?

GAME CONTENT (Early Access start)
20+ Unique powerful spells to unlock
20+ Types of ores
14+ Different enemies
10-Day cycle with boss fight and endless mode
Skill tree and progress system
Fully optimized for controller and STEAM DECK
